fixes.change: Remove the second logo block at top of EvidenceInspector; retain only the required header logo here and the opening-story placement, native aspect and colors unchanged.

Make the Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 tracks share one scale/baseline and place DOES NOT MATCH as a single bracket spanning the 40-unit gap; link each track bidirectionally to ev-cert-qty/ev-recv-qty.
Reduce inspector density so the primary Inspect source evidence action and the 2/70/3 metrics fit without clipped lower evidence at 1366x768; keep scrolling inside inspector only.
Separate ROUTE HEALTH · PRE-FLIGHT (nonce/identity health, no network request) from the INVESTIGATION task with distinct headings, status icons and focus order; do not style them as one control.
Add a visible keyboard focus ring and aria-describedby to the route select explaining Sample is offline/no live AI, and keep Run Sample investigation as the sole primary.
Dim non-feasible option cards in the SVG until investigation completes, while keeping their labels legible and non-interactive state explicit.
Keep typed consent tied to the selected option: show selected plan name, exact APPROVE phrase and 27-characters-remaining adjacent to the input, with error text announced politely on mismatch.
Replace small Select this path pills with full-card radio behaviour, 40px minimum target, arrow-key navigation and a clear selected check+text state.
Keep Accept recovery decision disabled with centre DecisionBar reason until the exact phrase matches; do not rely on color alone.
Label t1-t3 explicitly PROPOSED · UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on every card and in the SVG status strip, so approval state cannot be mistaken for tracked work.
Show the accepted 40+30=70 route MAT-ALLOY-B through CELL-MILL-1 only, with job allocations labelled on the SVG connectors.
Place Decline proposal as a secondary action with a confirmation consequence line; keep Approve Britt's proposal as the sole primary.

In the preview, keep CELL-MILL-2 header status ONLINE in the inspector but mark the SVG node PREVIEW · STOPPED with red outline/cross-hatch only on that node; clarify red means previewed stop, not yet applied.
Make the invalidation consequence a persistent centre DecisionBar warning before Apply second shock, naming the accepted plan that will be invalidated.
Remove or visually subordinate the admin Start a fresh scenario link during the guided step to prevent accidental reset; require separate confirmation if retained.
Preserve owner exception: CELL-MILL-2 uses stoppedRed outline, OFFLINE/STOPPED text and cross-hatch, while all other machines remain silver/neon; ensure no route is drawn through it.
Reconcile banner wording CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE · 3 -> 2 feasible paths with the option cards, greying Split as constrained with a text reason, not color alone.
Again separate pre-flight nonce/identity route health from Reinvestigate recovery evidence task, and state no model has run on the new snapshot yet adjacent to the primary.
Surface that Split is infeasible with a non-selectable radio, strikethrough-free text reason Requires two online compatible cells, and remove it from keyboard tab order as an option.
In typed consent, highlight what changed from the invalidated acceptance (capacity, feasible count) directly above the APPROVE field so revised consent is informed, not repeated blindly.
Compress the comparison cards so the consent input and character count are fully visible at 1366x768 without inspector clipping.
Keep Prior tracked work: 3 BLOCKED expanded by default enough to show coexistence: blocked prior tasks plus approved revised plan, while t1-t3 replacements remain PROPOSED · UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL.
Align DecisionBar status Approved revised plan · replacement tasks await approval with the board header so tracked vs untracked counts match.
Add per-task dependency text after Ready/after t1/after t2 as a small timeline in the inspector, mirrored as static markers on the SVG.
Sequence the proof actions 1 Seal, 2 Verify ledger, 3 Export independent checkpoint with numbered states; disable later steps until prerequisites complete and explain why in text.
Resolve status mismatch: stage strip says Human recovery accepted · 3 tracked tasks while inspector says 3 tracked · 0 done · 0 blocked; use one tracked/blocked/done source everywhere.
Shorten passphrase guidance to one line above the field and move detailed rules into a disclosure, restoring vertical fit at 1366x768.
Mark completion distinctly from Step 9: change rail state to checked Recovery story complete, set aria-current on completion, and keep Review recovery proof as the sole primary.

In the sealed summary, explicitly retain revised plan accepted, prior acceptance invalidated and CELL-MILL-2 offline in three short proof lines; do not invent counts beyond the shown 18 events/70 parts.
Mask the passphrase field visually as completed without displaying character count equivalence, and label Seal/Verify/Export each Complete · current ledger with matching check icons.
